title: Hyp Kummer Prime
objective: Implement packed source-transparent genus-2 prime-field Kummer duplication, pseudo-addition, and scalar batches with exact reference differentials.

handoff.summary: Implemented three source-transparent packed kernels and a bounded prepared context for genus-2 Kummer projection, Flynn quartic duplication, safe degenerate differential addition, repeated 2-power scalar batches, and sign-free 2-power annihilation. The exact envelope is odd primes p <= 2^32-1, odd quintics with one point at infinity, deg(h) <= 2, the shared 8-word canonical Mumford ABI, and normalized 4-word Kummer coordinates. Exhaustive F_3/F_5 classical/generalized Jacobians agree with Cantor doubling, CPython specialized plans agree with the immutable sparse Flynn oracle, native compilation is host-isolated with zero callbacks, and the production Wasm bridge classifies all three kernels as supported. On idle bench-1, normalized native duplication sustained about 1.128 million points/second and packed projection about 34.9 million points/second; the same CPython body sustained about 19.2 thousand duplications/second.
risks: General Flynn biquadratic pseudo-addition is not yet implemented: xADD is exact only when either input is the identity or A-B is the identity (duplication); all other rows return KUMMER_UNSUPPORTED_DIFFERENTIAL.
The module currently imports _CLASSICAL_DELTA_1 through _CLASSICAL_DELTA_4 from genus2_kummer.py, which is an upward BSD-layer edge for a public Jacobian dependency.
The local architecture gate reaches the package graph but fails because this module raises hyperelliptic-curves-algorithms to 619263 bytes versus its current 610000-byte budget.
The actual Wasm execution differential is conditionally skipped without a complete WASI FLINT toolchain; bridge classification is always tested.
No native Windows/macOS/aarch64 execution receipt was collected in this lane; the fixed uint64 source ABI and dynamic fallbacks are platform-neutral but still need integration-matrix validation.
next_steps: Move the four immutable Flynn tables verbatim, preserving tuple order/content, plus preferably the generic sparse evaluator into neutral genus2_kummer_formulas.py; have both genus2_kummer.py and this module import that single audited source.
Raise or rebalance the hyperelliptic-curves-algorithms lazy byte budget in the integration lane.
Construct/cache this context from J.prepared_arithmetic() after exposing original f/h coefficient buffers, then route 2-primary annihilation filters through it.
Add the full audited Flynn biquadratic forms before advertising general differential addition or arbitrary Kummer-only scalar multiplication.
Register the three kernels in the production native/Wasm manifest and run the conditional exact Wasm differential on a configured toolchain.
